messages:
maria-ops: FYI seeing a sharp sustained burst hitting dedicated reserved pool rp-ap-sg-2 for ~3m. admission controller started shedding to hosted.
capacity-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-17T06:26:29Z reserved_pool=rp-ap-sg-2 action=admit_reject threshold=0.92 qlen=128 avg_lat_ms=312
jordan-sre: timeline? noise from a partner or internal churn?
liam-rt: correlated to tenant t-7432, long-context chat streams, tokens/sec x12 spike.
sophie-pm: that's the new partner launch. they planned to ramp but expected hosted fallback — not heavy dedicated thrash.
maria-ops: fallback did start but fairshare hit and then admission rejected earliest requests. customers saw 429s.
kai-alloc: can we route them to a quantized compatible model variant instead of rejecting?
jordan-sre: policy: pool_sat>90% and qlen>100 => start rejecting non-SLA. auto-variant-fallback would help but needs code.
liam-rt: short term: open emergency burst reservations and bump allocator weight for rp-ap-sg-2.
maria-ops: burst capacity in this AZ = 0 (we used it earlier). capacity-bot: [METRIC] 2026-03-17T06:27:01Z pool=rp-ap-sg-2 free_gpus=0 migratable_pods=3 pending_evictions=4
jordan-sre: Plan A: 1) preempt low-priority in rp-ap-sg-2, 2) move t-7432 to hosted fallback (notify partner), 3) throttle non-SLA with rate-limit backstop.
sophie-pm: note: moving partner to hosted changes latency/billing, we'll notify.
liam-rt: dry-run preempt: `/runbook preempt --pool rp-ap-sg-2 --priority low --max=6` (dry-run)
maria-ops: dry-run -> 4 pods eligible, ~48GB GPU mem reclaimed -> ~2 infer slots
maria-ops: executing `preempt --pool rp-ap-sg-2 --priority low --max=6` now
capacity-bot: [ACTION] 2026-03-17T06:28:45Z preempted=3 freed_slots=2.1 expected_latency_ms_increase=+18
kai-alloc: toggle emergency allocator experiment to allow short burst reservations? will auto-revert.
liam-rt: yes, tag emergency and auto-revert in 30m.
maria-ops: `allocator.burst_emergency=true` for rp-ap-sg-2
capacity-bot: [STATE] 2026-03-17T06:29:12Z burst_reservations=2 reserved_gpus=8
sophie-pm: partner webhook sent to t-7432 telling them we're routing to hosted fallback.
partner-bot: [OUTBOUND] webhook to partner t-7432 delivered status=200 body="Failover to hosted fallback initiated"
liam-rt: qlen down 128->84, avg_lat 312->235ms
maria-ops: propose relaxing admission threshold from 0.92 -> 0.96 while burst reservations active.
jordan-sre: applying flag `admission.threshold=0.96` monitoring SLOs
capacity-bot: [METRIC] 2026-03-17T06:31:00Z qlen=62 avg_lat_ms=198 admitted_rate=+15%
maria-ops: consider converting long-context sessions (>=8k) to KV-cached or compact prompts; client-side preferred but we can proxy-rewrite requests.
kai-alloc: runtime-rewrite branch has a quick transformer to compact prompts; can rate-limit rollout.
sophie-pm: eng-frontend to coordinate with partner; they prefer not to change client.
maria-ops: status: preempt done, burst toggled, partner notified, admission flag updated.
jordan-sre: alert stays open 1hr, escalate to oncall-lead if qlen stops falling.
liam-rt: postmortem owners: eng-runtime + customer-success for partner comms.
sophie-pm: I'll own comms; please dump compact timeline and root cause hypothesis after stable.
maria-ops: compact timeline:
```
06:26:29 - surge detected qlen 128 avg_lat 312ms
06:27:01 - burst capacity 0; preempt dry-run
06:28:45 - preempted 3 pods freed 2 slots
06:29:12 - burst emergency reservations applied
06:31:00 - qlen 62 avg_lat 198ms
06:35:12 - pool stable qlen 18 avg_lat 95ms
```
maria-ops: marking thread status: stabilizing — will update when fully resolved :white_check_mark:
capacity-bot: [ALERT CLEAR] 2026-03-17T06:35:12Z pool=rp-ap-sg-2 state=stable qlen=18 avg_lat=95
sophie-pm: follow-ups: add auto-variant-fallback, review burst-eviction, improve burst budget bookkeeping.
maria-ops: noted. closing ops window in 30m unless regression.
partner-bot: partner t-7432 acknowledged: "Thanks for the quick switch, we'll throttle our ramp for next hour."
